# Federated medallion frontier experiments

Conductor track:
`conductor/tracks/federated_medallion_frontier_experiments_20260829/`

Evaluate remote DuckDB/Polars/Arrow and optional DataFusion, Hugging Face Xet
and resumable object mechanics, Iceberg REST/v3, Merkle/RO-Crate/Croissant/
OpenLineage attestations, and deterministic NetworkX/Neo4j/Cypher/RDF/semantic
projections over exact public medallion revisions.

Reuse prior datahouse experiment evidence. Every candidate needs a measured
requirement, baseline, threshold, fallback, rollback, threat/rights/cost review,
and explicit disposition. This track does not promote production dependencies.

Requirements: M-112, C-011, C-012, C-013, C-014, C-015, W-005.
